title: ECG foundation-model embeddings distinguish later cognitive impairment beyond age
summary: In a retrospective two-site Korean cohort (development n=52,355; external n=6,500), embeddings from a knowledge-enhanced diagnosis foundation model supported an ECG-only classifier that discriminated patients diagnosed with cognitive impairment or dementia within 10 years from matched controls, using only ECGs read as normal sinus rhythm. An age-only model was compared with late fusion of age and ECG-derived probability, and age-residualized embeddings were tested for age-independent information. Numeric AUROC results were not visible in the abstract; the data are retrospective and from two Korean sites.
ai_technology: ECG-only classifier on foundation-model embeddings (knowledge-enhanced diagnosis foundation model)
organization: Yonsei University; Yonsei University Health System

evidence.tested: External validation (n=6,500) at a second hospital comparing against an age-only model.
evidence.unknown: Numeric AUROC and NRI values, and prospective or non-Korean performance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classifier on ECG embeddings predicts later cognitive impairment or dementia
